entities.summary: HNLMS Kortenaer was an Admiralen-class destroyer operated by the Royal Netherlands Navy between 1928 and 1942. Equipped to also operate as a minelayer, she was built to defend the Dutch East Indies and to safeguard Dutch colonial possessions throughout the world. The first decade of her service was largely routine, with alternating periods in the Caribbean, Southeast Asia, and Europe. In 1929, she was a part of the Dutch response to an attack on Curaçao by Venezuelan rebels, although she arrived too late to have an effect.
